description: Use before writing or fixing symbolator VHDL component symbols for render_diagram (format symbolator): rules checked against the renderer, worked examples, identifier rule.
identifier: symbolator draws one symbol per `entity`; the entity name and port names are the only text, with no separate label. Use the identifier directly as the entity or port name when it is a valid VHDL identifier (letters, digits, underscore): `entity n0002 is`. Never invent identifiers.
